description: One record = one denudation-rate value at one site (or one sample / one catchment) from one source. Fields marked required must be present (null allowed only where 'nullable' is true). Values are recorded as reported, then normalised by scripts/validate.py.

record_id.doc: <proxy>_<first-author-surname><year>_<n>, e.g. mem_smith1999_3. Unique across the database.

rate_value.doc: Denudation / lowering rate exactly as reported (positive = lowering).

rate_uncertainty.doc: Reported uncertainty, same unit as rate_value. null if not reported.

rate_unit.doc: Unit as reported. Mass units need rock_density_g_cm3.

rate_mm_kyr.doc: Filled by validate.py. Do not enter by hand.

rate_type.doc: Which model component this value can validate. Defaults come from proxies.json; override only with a reason in notes.

n_measurements.doc: Number of measurement points / samples averaged into this value.

proxy.doc: Controlled vocabulary: an id from schema/proxies.json.

method_detail.doc: Free text: instrument, surface orientation, sample type, model used, etc.

integration_time_yr.doc: Time span the rate averages over (MEM: monitoring period; cosmogenic: apparent age / integration time).

measurement_period.doc: Calendar period for short-term methods, e.g. '1978-1996'.

latitude.doc: Decimal degrees WGS84. Convert DMS. null if not given (do not geocode by guess).

geographic_setting.doc: inland = no marine influence; coastal = within sea-spray / coastal climate influence on a continent; island = small island / exposed platform.

marine_zone.doc: Crucial for coastal MEM data: intertidal shore-platform rates are NOT subaerial denudation.

distance_to_coast_km.doc: As reported or measured; may be filled later by GIS.

precip_source.doc: 'reported' = from the paper. 'gridded_dataset' only when filled later from e.g. WorldClim/CHELSA (name it in notes).

slope_deg.doc: Local surface slope (MEM: surface dip) or catchment-mean slope (catchment methods). Convert % to degrees: atan(p/100).

lithology_detail.doc: Formation name, purity (% CaCO3), facies, etc. as reported.

carbonate_fraction.doc: 0-1. Catchment fraction of carbonate outcrop (catchment methods) or CaCO3 content of the rock.

rock_density_g_cm3.doc: As reported; validate.py uses 2.7 for mass-unit conversion if null and records that in qc_flags.

citation.doc: Author(s) Year, short form, e.g. 'Smith & Jones 1999'.

doi.doc: Bare DOI, lower case, no https://doi.org/ prefix.

source_location.doc: Where the number is in the source: 'Table 2, row 4', 'p. 512, para 3', 'Fig. 5 (digitised)'.

source_quote.doc: Verbatim snippet (<= 300 chars) containing the number, or the table row. null only for figure-digitised values.

source_database.doc: If taken from a compilation (e.g. 'OCTOPUS v2'), name it here and still cite the original study in citation/doi.

confidence.doc: high = number and site attributes stated explicitly; medium = some attributes inferred from text; low = digitised or ambiguous.

verified_by.doc: Initials of the human who checked the record against the source. Records with null are excluded from the 'verified' export.
